# ADR-0001: The citing record

Decision 1 restates what the cited record already says, "the arm gets a
field" (`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:3`).

Decision 2 points at a line whose recorded text has since changed, "A second
decision, whose recorded text" (`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:5`).

Decision 3 names a line and quotes nothing at all
(`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:7`).

Decision 4 points past the end of the record it cites
(`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:999`).

Decision 5 quotes "a phrase that appears in neither record" and points at a
line that does not contain it (`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:9`).

Decision 6 cites a list, "A third line, cited by a paragraph"
(`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:7`, `:11`).

Decision 7 cites the first decision again ("the arm gets a field")
(`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:3`). Wrapping `:97` above it would move that line,
which is the failure this record's own citation would suffer.
